role: The renderer's precision (lane/renderprec): the mask of the stages drawn fast (RP_XFORM, RP_EDGE, RP_LIGHT, RP_COLOR, RP_FOG, RP_SHADE, RP_RCP; RP_EXACT 0, the default and the mode judged against Java; RP_FAST all), rp_h (a float rounded to float16, ties to even) and rp_parse (exact, fast, fast:STAGE,...). The C renderer and the device renderer (csrc/cuda/render) take the same mask.
notes: No Java counterpart: exact is vanilla's arithmetic (the frames the judges hold to Java), fast a reduced-precision mode for the RL observation. rp_h equals gcc's _Float16 conversion on all 2^32 floats (checked once, lane/renderprec).
